title: Turnover: which minutes belong to the period
goal: Compare virtual-table75 with two actual 30/45 movements.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P5. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: A customer has two posted requests.75 is correct for one period, but not necessarily for every report. Specify the time range and customer before adding rows.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Accumulation without a balance
paragraphs: Delivered services often need volume during a period, not an end-of-day obligation. A turnover register stores numeric facts for aggregation by dimensions. Do not invent receipt/expense semantics merely because balance registers are familiar. First ask whether the resource has a meaningful balance and explain it concretely.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: Two own requests of 30 and 45 are posted on the same day. The Обороты virtual table returns 75 for that customer and period. A separate raw query confirms two recorders. An earlier empty period has no matching rows.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Interval and granularity
paragraphs: A weekly 60-minute turnover differs from a 20-minute closing obligation. Specify boundaries and grouping. One document with two services may create two records, so movement count differs from document count. Count recorder identities when the question asks for documents.
The virtual Обороты table accepts begin/end and Клиент=&Клиент. It represents computed platform totals, not a stored table containing 75. The full code selects МинутыОборот as Минуты.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: The second request is moved to the following day, beyond the end boundary. Should the first day include its 40 minutes?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Customer matching and period membership are both required. A document’s existence does not add its movements to every time window.

sections.title: A repeat does not create another fact
paragraphs: Reposting replaces the current recorder’s set. Appending without replacement makes report volume grow after every correction. Test one two-line document, repost, line change and reversal. Reconcile by service and grand total while preserving document sources.

Verify 75 and two source-register rows filtered by your customer. An earlier empty period has no turnover. Exact endpoint events require an explicit inclusion policy; these movements lie inside a day and do not prove every time-boundary combination.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The worked 30+45 total follows filtering. In the independent task 20 and 40 fall into different windows, so two distinct queries are required.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Filtering the customer but leaving the period too wide yields 60 instead of 20. The arithmetic can be correct while answering a different question. Check boundaries instead of adjusting arithmetic to the desired number.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Empty periods and boundaries
paragraphs: Test an empty period and records exactly at agreed boundaries. Including a whole final day must follow an explicit rule, not accidental parameter precision. Do not change document dates to force a match: correct the report condition in a separate copy.
The 46 mutation gives 76 instead of 75 while retaining two recorders. Test count and resource separately. Labor turnover is not remaining obligations: those are distinct questions/registers.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Create and post new requests of 20 minutes on 2 November 12:00 and 40 minutes on 3 November 12:00. The 2 November 00:00→3 November 00:00 window must return 20; ending on 4 November 00:00 must return 60. Another new customer without movements must not inherit that turnover.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.
